invoiceWorkbench.leaveConfirmContent: {{summary}}. Leaving without saving will discard them.

invoiceWorkbench.noRowsToExecute: Nothing to run. Check at least one group.
invoiceWorkbench.largePriceChangeTitle: Purchase price moved more than {{limit}}% — confirm again
invoiceWorkbench.largePriceChangeContent: {{count}} rows moved more than {{limit}}% from the last purchase price. Confirming will write them to the product master and store prices. Check that a case quantity or case price was not entered as a unit price.
invoiceWorkbench.linkMatchedTip: For rows not in the product master whose barcode matches exactly one existing product, fill in that product code and treat the row as an existing product
invoiceWorkbench.linkMatchedNone: No selected rows can be linked: rows must be checked as not in the product master and have a barcode match
invoiceWorkbench.linkMatchedConfirmTitle: Link products that uniquely match the barcode?
invoiceWorkbench.linkMatchedConfirmContent: Will look up barcode matches for {{count}} rows. Rows matching exactly one product get that product code and are treated as existing products (default: update purchase price); the product master is unchanged. Rows matching several products are skipped for manual choice.
invoiceWorkbench.linkMatchedSkipped: {{count}} other rows are not eligible (already in the product master, not checked, or no barcode match) and are left as is.
invoiceWorkbench.linkMatchedNothing: No rows match exactly one product: {{multi}} match several products, {{failed}} lookups failed
invoiceWorkbench.linkMatchedResultDetail: Rows still need manual handling: {{multi}} match several products, {{failed}} lookups failed, {{rejected}} could not be linked. Click the barcode status to choose row by row.
